description: Human visual spot checks in source pixels. Approximate blur centres, not exhaustive frame annotations. Labels were drawn from source-only contact sheets; tracker coordinates were not used to choose centres. Results were run before finalizing the spot checks, so this is exploratory validation, not a blinded benchmark. References finalized after a source-only native-resolution verification pass. Two clips are exploratory development examples and must not become a claimed held-out benchmark.

clips.bounce_reference_reason: Ground contact could not be independently localized confidently through the batter/pad overlap. Do not interpret unresolved as a correct rejection or as a full toss.

Potential ground contact is obscured by the batter/pads and bat motion. Screen recording contains repeated frames; container FPS is not a reliable source exposure rate. No bounce-frame error can be scored.
